SD40-X03.name: The 33rdGenerationWindDemonHead Yatagarai
SD40-X03.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 6 ([Green Core][Green Core][Green Core][Red Core])]
Exhaust three opposing Spirits/Ultimates, and for each target exhausted, refresh a Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put two cores from the Void to any of your Spirits.

SD40-X02.name: The 44thGenerationStrangeFangShinobiHead Shishinobi
SD40-X02.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Destroy four opposing 12000 BP or less Spirits. Effects of the Spirits destroyed by this effect can't activate. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. From among them, summon any number of "Ninja Gale" family Spirit cards/Brave cards without paying the cost. Add any remaining cards to the Hand.

SD40-004.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Barakiri
SD40-004.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - (Either Attack Step)
This card can be summoned from your Removed Zone by paying the cost and putting cores onto it using cores from your Reserve.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Green Core][Green Core])]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

SD40-003.name: The FlameSannin Izayoi of the GreatShuriken
SD40-003.effect:
Flash- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two symbols or more. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Destroyed)
You can summon a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

SD40-002.name: The FlameSannin Kayaku of the Explosion
SD40-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Ignoring the "BP +" of Braves, by destroying an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.

SD40-001.name: The FlameSannin Saizo of the WickedHeart
SD40-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When any player would summon "God-King"/"Ten Crown"/"Imagine" family Spirit cards/Brave cards, unless the player sends a core from their Life to the Void for each card to be summoned, they can't be summoned. Bursts can't activate via this effect.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, but it can't attack/block, and loses its symbol.

SD40-X01.name: The NinjaHead Souldragon-Hokage
SD40-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Infinite Flame] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. When that battling Spirit is depleted/destroyed, for every Symbol on this Spirit, send a core from the opposing Life to their Reserve, and refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card, and the opponent can't activate their Bursts.

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with [Ultra Armor]. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD40-007.name: The StrangeFangShinobi Tachikage
SD40-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbols are also treated as Red.

SD40-006.name: The WindDemon Ikaruga
SD40-006.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. Also, if this Spirit was summoned via an effect, refresh a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit you control.

SD40-005.effect:

When your Spirit with [Accel] effects, or your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit with [Soul Core] on it attacks, return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.
